items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: One, Manier Richley, that's my brother

ctx.x: Do you remember, can you, actually, you know their name, what were their names?

One, Manier Richley, that's my brother, and my other was U-S-A-M, U-S-A-M. I like my daddy. See? He played baritone. He was pretty good baritone. But there wasn't nothing in it much for dancing. They didn't make that. So they didn't.
Who would you see? They wanted to work. I was going to ask, is that how you got your sort of nickname, your little name?
